# stalwart_smime_trust_anchor (Resource)

Additional certificate authority trusted when validating recipient S/MIME certificates.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `certificate` (String) CA certificate in PEM format
- `description` (String) Description of the certificate authority
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the certificate authority is trusted

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) Expiration date of the CA certificate, taken from the certificate itself
- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
- `subject` (String) Subject of the CA certificate, taken from the certificate itself
